about.bio: I am an Informatics Engineering student at Pamulang University with a strong curiosity for technology and how it can be used to solve real-world problems. Alongside my academic journey, I continue to learn through projects, experiences, and new challenges. This portfolio represents that journey — documenting what I have built, what I have learned, and how I continue to grow.
